quote: the Bass–Quillen conjecture was first formulated in 1973. Hyman Bass presented the conjecture in his work "Some problems in 'classical' algebraic K-theory," published as part of the Springer-Verlag volume "Algebraic K-Theory II" that year
note: Daniel Quillen also contributed to the development of the conjecture with his publication in 1976
